# jsQR

Unmodified distribution and Apache-2.0 license from
[cozmo/jsQR](https://github.com/cozmo/jsQR/tree/8e6a036beafa7053dd44b1b76ac578d22b1b3311).

Revision: `8e6a036beafa7053dd44b1b76ac578d22b1b3311`.
SHA256 of `jsQR.js`: `3325b0888fa4745c4e6940897d8c4f426fbaae76901fcbfe1871a04e90a51655`.

Used to decode camera RGBA pixels locally in a dedicated worker, without a
platform BarcodeDetector requirement or a second camera stream. No network
decoding service is used. Include `JSQR_LICENSE.txt` when redistributing.
